newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to launch optic phone link to Macedonia.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to launch optic phone link to Macedonia.

text.p: Bulgaria will open an optic telephone link to Macedonia this week as part of a planned telecommunications route connecting Western Europe with the Middle East, officials said on Monday.

Bulgarian Telecommunications Company (BTC) spokeswoman Vera Pavlova said the stretch, to be officially launched on Thursday, would link Bulgaria's southwestern town of Kyustendil with the Macedonian town of Kriva Palanka.

"The 20-km (12.5 mile) stretch from Kyustendil via Gjueshevo to Kriva Palanka is part of the international trans-Balkan route from Brindisi in Italy through Albania, Macedonia, and Bulgaria to Istanbul in Turkey," Pavlova said.
The link was built by Italtel, who won a tender in 1995, she said.
A new international digital exchange in Kyustendil, built by France's Alcatel Cable SA, will also be opened on Thursday, Pavlova said.
The new digital stretch, linking Sofia and Skopje, will meet international traffic needs, she said.
